description: Defines the HttpResponse class template for handling HTTP responses over asynchronous sockets, including methods for writing headers, status, chunked data, upgrading to WebSocket, and managing connection state.

classes.name: HttpResponse
classes.description: A template class for managing HTTP responses over an asynchronous socket, supporting headers, status, chunked transfer, WebSocket upgrade, and connection control.

methods.name: writeUnsignedHex
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer in hexadecimal format to the socket.

methods.name: writeUnsigned64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer to the socket.

methods.name: writeMark
methods.description: Writes standard headers like Date and optional version info.

methods.name: internalEnd
methods.description: Handles the logic for ending the HTTP response, including chunked transfer, content length, and connection closing.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the HTTP connection to a WebSocket, performing handshake and socket adoption.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses reading and writing on the socket.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes reading and writing on the socket.

methods.name: writeContinue
methods.description: Sends a 100 Continue response.

methods.name: writeStatus
methods.description: Writes the HTTP status line.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Writes an HTTP header with string or unsigned integer value.

methods.name: endWithoutBody
methods.description: Ends the response without a body or with a spoofed content length.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the response, optionally with data.

methods.name: tryEnd
methods.description: Attempts to end the response, returning success status.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a chunk of data in chunked transfer encoding.

methods.name: getWriteOffset
methods.description: Returns the current write offset.

methods.name: overrideWriteOffset
methods.description: Overrides the current write offset.

methods.name: hasResponded
methods.description: Checks if the response has been fully sent.

methods.name: cork
methods.description: Corks the socket to batch writes, with a handler executed during corking.

methods.name: onWritable
methods.description: Attaches a handler for when the socket becomes writable.

methods.name: onAborted
methods.description: Attaches a handler for when the request is aborted.

methods.name: onData
methods.description: Attaches a handler for incoming data.
